items.raw_excerpt: Thrissur gears up for a vibrant Pulikkali celebration with over 400 painted tigers parading for Onam festivities this Saturday.
items.summary_en: Over 400 painted tigers will parade through Thrissur as part of Pulikkali, a colorful Onam festival tradition. The vibrant celebration brings together performers in tiger costumes for a lively street performance this Saturday.
items.summary_ko: 오남 축제를 맞아 스리수르에서 풀리칼리 전통 축제가 열린다. 페인트로 칠해진 호랑이 의상을 입은 400명 이상의 참가자가 거리 행진을 펼칠 예정이다.
items.title_en: 'Tigers' Set to Make Merry in Thrissur
items.title_ko: 스리수르 풀리칼리 축제에 호랑이 400마리 넘게 행진
items.title_original: ‘Tigers’ set to make merry in Thrissur

items.raw_excerpt: Discover how Peace by the Gram, a small-town cannabis store in Matheson, Ontario, achieved $1M in sales through community connections and keeping overhead low.
items.summary_en: Peace by the Gram, a cannabis store in Matheson, Ontario, reached $1 million in sales. The store focused on low overhead and building relationships with local residents. Their success shows how small-town businesses can thrive by listening to their community.
items.summary_ko: 온타리오주 매디슨에 위치한 Peace by the Gram 대마초 판매점이 100만 달러 매출을 기록했습니다. 이 매장은 낮은 운영비용과 지역 주민과의 관계 구축에 집중하며 성공을 거두었습니다. 작은 마을에서도 지역사회와 소통하면 성공할 수 있다는 것을 보여주는 사례입니다.
items.title_en: Small-Town Cannabis Store Hits $1M in Sales Through Community Connections
items.title_ko: 매디슨 소규모 대마초 판매점, 지역민 소통으로 100만 달러 매출 달성
items.title_original: Peace by the Gram: How a Small-Town Cannabis Store Finds Success Through Listening - StratCann

items.raw_excerpt: Lucky draws for Indiramma Housing flats in Hyderabad begin today, running from August 28 to 31 across four constituencies.
items.summary_en: Lucky draws for Indiramma Housing flats in Hyderabad begin today and run through August 31. The draws cover four constituencies in the city.
